crops.name: Basmati Rice
crops.description: A long-grain aromatic rice, primarily grown in the Indian subcontinent.

crops.name: Wheat
crops.description: A staple cereal grain, a key source of carbohydrates.

crops.name: Sugarcane
crops.description: A tall perennial grass used for sugar production.

crops.name: Cotton
crops.description: A soft, fluffy staple fiber that grows in a boll.

crops.name: Soybean
crops.description: A species of legume native to East Asia, widely grown for its edible bean.

crops.name: Maize (Corn)
crops.description: A large grain plant first domesticated by indigenous peoples in southern Mexico.

crops.name: Potato
crops.description: A starchy tuber of the nightshade family Solanaceae, and the plant itself.

crops.name: Tomato
crops.description: A glossy red, or occasionally yellow, pulpy edible fruit that is eaten as a vegetable.

crops.name: Onion
crops.description: A vegetable which is the most widely cultivated species of the genus Allium.

crops.name: Mustard
crops.description: A plant species in the genera Brassica and Sinapis in the family Brassicaceae.

crops.name: Jowar (Sorghum)
crops.description: A genus of flowering plants in the grass family Poaceae. Most species are native to Australia.

crops.name: Bajra (Pearl Millet)
crops.description: The most widely grown type of millet. It has been grown in Africa and the Indian subcontinent since prehistoric times.

crops.name: Gram (Chickpea)
crops.description: An annual legume of the family Fabaceae, subfamily Faboideae.

crops.name: Groundnut (Peanut)
crops.description: A legume crop grown mainly for its edible seeds. It is widely grown in the tropics and subtropics.

crops.name: Lentil (Masoor)
crops.description: An edible legume. It is an annual plant known for its lens-shaped seeds.

crops.name: Barley (Jau)
crops.description: A member of the grass family, it is a major cereal grain grown in temperate climates globally.

crops.name: Sunflower
crops.description: A large annual forb of the genus Helianthus grown as a crop for its edible oil and edible fruits.

crops.name: Turmeric
crops.description: A flowering plant, Curcuma longa of the ginger family, Zingiberaceae, the roots of which are used in cooking.

crops.name: Ginger
crops.description: A flowering plant whose rhizome, ginger root or ginger, is widely used as a spice and a folk medicine.

crops.name: Ragi (Finger Millet)
crops.description: An annual herbaceous plant widely grown as a cereal crop in the arid and semiarid areas in Africa and Asia.

crops.name: Pigeon Pea (Tur/Arhar)
crops.description: A perennial legume from the family Fabaceae. Since its domestication in the Indian subcontinent at least 3,500 years ago, its seeds have become a common food in Asia, Africa, and Latin America.

crops.name: Black Gram (Urad)
crops.description: A bean grown in the Indian subcontinent. It, along with the mung bean, was domesticated in India from its wild progenitor Vigna sublobata.

crops.name: Green Gram (Moong)
crops.description: A plant species in the legume family. The mung bean is mainly cultivated in East Asia, Southeast Asia and the Indian subcontinent.

crops.name: Pomegranate
crops.description: A fruit-bearing deciduous shrub in the family Lythraceae, subfamily Punicoideae, that grows between 5 and 10 m tall.

crops.name: Guava
crops.description: A common tropical fruit cultivated in many tropical and subtropical regions.
crops.soil_type: Wide range, from heavy clay to very light sandy soils

crops.name: Papaya
crops.description: The fruit of the plant Carica papaya, in the genus Carica. It is native to the tropics of the Americas.

crops.name: Banana
crops.description: An elongated, edible fruit – botanically a berry – produced by several kinds of large herbaceous flowering plants in the genus Musa.

crops.name: Pineapple
crops.description: A tropical plant with an edible fruit and the most economically significant plant in the family Bromeliaceae.

crops.name: Litchi
crops.description: The sole member of the genus Litchi in the soapberry family, Sapindaceae.

crops.name: Jackfruit
crops.description: A species of tree in the fig, mulberry, and breadfruit family (Moraceae).

crops.name: Cauliflower
crops.description: One of several vegetables in the species Brassica oleracea in the genus Brassica, which is in the Brassicaceae (or mustard) family.

crops.name: Cabbage
crops.description: A leafy green, red (purple), or white (pale green) biennial plant grown as an annual vegetable crop for its dense-leaved heads.

crops.name: Brinjal (Eggplant)
crops.description: A plant species in the nightshade family Solanaceae. Solanum melongena is grown worldwide for its edible fruit.

crops.name: Okra (Lady's Finger)
crops.description: A flowering plant in the mallow family. It is valued for its edible green seed pods.

crops.name: Capsicum
crops.description: A genus of flowering plants in the nightshade family Solanaceae. Its species are native to the Americas.

crops.name: Carrot
crops.description: A root vegetable, usually orange in color, though purple, black, red, white, and yellow cultivars exist.

crops.name: Radish
crops.description: An edible root vegetable of the family Brassicaceae that was domesticated in Asia prior to Roman times.

crops.name: Beetroot
crops.description: The taproot portion of a beet plant, usually known in North America as the beet, and also known as the table beet or garden beet.

crops.name: Garlic
crops.description: A species in the onion genus, Allium. Its close relatives include the onion, shallot, leek, chive, and Chinese onion.

crops.name: Cucumber
crops.description: A widely-cultivated creeping vine plant in the Cucurbitaceae gourd family that bears cucumiform fruits.

crops.name: Bottle Gourd
crops.description: A vine grown for its fruit, which can be harvested young and used as a vegetable, or harvested mature, dried, and used as a bottle, utensil, or pipe.

crops.name: Bitter Gourd
crops.description: A tropical and subtropical vine of the family Cucurbitaceae, widely grown in Asia, Africa, and the Caribbean for its edible fruit.

crops.name: Pumpkin
crops.description: A cultivar of a squash plant, most commonly of Cucurbita pepo, that is round, with smooth, slightly ribbed skin, and deep yellow to orange coloration.

crops.name: Spinach
crops.description: A leafy green flowering plant native to central and western Asia.

crops.name: Tea
crops.description: An aromatic beverage prepared by pouring hot or boiling water over cured or fresh leaves of Camellia sinensis, an evergreen shrub native to East Asia.

crops.name: Coffee
crops.description: A brewed drink prepared from roasted coffee beans, the seeds of berries from certain Coffea species.
crops.soil_type: Deep, friable, porous, and well-drained loamy soil

crops.name: Rubber
crops.description: Consists of polymers of the organic compound isoprene, with minor impurities of other organic compounds, plus water.

crops.name: Cashew
crops.description: A tropical evergreen tree that produces the cashew seed and the cashew apple.

crops.name: Coconut
crops.description: The fruit of the coconut palm (Cocos nucifera). It's used for its water, milk, oil, and meat.

crops.name: Jute
crops.description: A long, soft, shiny bast fiber that can be spun into coarse, strong threads.

crops.name: Saffron
crops.description: A spice derived from the flower of Crocus sativus, commonly known as the 'saffron crocus'.

crops.name: Coriander
crops.description: An annual herb in the family Apiaceae. It is also known as Chinese parsley, dhania, or cilantro.

crops.name: Cumin
crops.description: A flowering plant in the family Apiaceae, native to a territory including the Middle East and stretching east to India.

crops.name: Fennel
crops.description: A flowering plant species in the carrot family. It is a hardy, perennial herb with yellow flowers and feathery leaves.

crops.name: Castor
crops.description: A species of perennial flowering plant in the spurge family, Euphorbiaceae. It is the sole species in the monotypic genus, Ricinus, and subtribe, Ricininae.

crops.name: Linseed (Flax)
crops.description: A flowering plant, Linum usitatissimum, in the family Linaceae. It is cultivated as a food and fiber crop in regions of the world with temperate climate.

crops.name: Sesame
crops.description: A flowering plant in the genus Sesamum, also called benne. Numerous wild relatives occur in Africa and a smaller number in India.

crops.name: Apple
crops.description: A fruit that grows on an apple tree (Malus domestica). Apple trees are cultivated worldwide and are the most widely grown species in the genus Malus.

crops.name: Orange
crops.description: The fruit of various citrus species in the family Rutaceae; it primarily refers to Citrus × sinensis, which is also called sweet orange.

crops.name: Grapes
crops.description: A fruit, botanically a berry, of the deciduous woody vines of the flowering plant genus Vitis.

crops.name: Mango
crops.description: A stone fruit produced from numerous species of tropical trees belonging to the flowering plant genus Mangifera.

crops.name: Chilli
crops.description: The fruit of plants from the genus Capsicum which are members of the nightshade family, Solanaceae.

crops.name: Cardamom
crops.description: A spice made from the seeds of several plants in the genera Elettaria and Amomum in the family Zingiberaceae.

crops.name: Pepper
crops.description: A flowering vine in the family Piperaceae, cultivated for its fruit, known as a peppercorn, which is usually dried and used as a spice and seasoning.

crops.name: Arecanut
crops.description: The fruit of the areca palm (Areca catechu), which grows in much of the tropical Pacific, Southeast and South Asia, and parts of east Africa.
crops.soil_type: Laterite, red loam, and alluvial soils

crops.name: Walnut
crops.description: The nut of any tree of the genus Juglans (Family Juglandaceae), particularly the Persian or English walnut, Juglans regia.

crops.name: Almond
crops.description: A species of tree native to Iran and surrounding countries but widely cultivated elsewhere.

crops.name: Kiwi
crops.description: The edible berries of several species of woody vines in the genus Actinidia.

crops.name: Dragon Fruit
crops.description: The fruit of several different cactus species indigenous to the Americas.

crops.name: Custard Apple
crops.description: A common name for a fruit, and the tree which bears it, Annona reticulata.
